rationale.description: Why these slices and these values. Recorded verbatim with the round.

edits.description: At most one entry per tensor. Together these overwrite complete rows or columns.

tensor_name.description: Must be one of the tensor_name values in sites.json.

axis.description: 0 overwrites complete rows (one per index). 1 overwrites complete columns.

indices.description: Strictly ascending, unique, each below the size of that axis.

values.description: One slice of numbers per index, in the same order as indices. A row of length shape[1] when axis is 0, a column of length shape[0] when axis is 1.

notes.indices: strictly ascending, unique, in [0, axis size)
notes.values: one slice per index: shape[1] numbers for axis 0, shape[0] for axis 1
